text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
Rhein Kraft was troubled. What must she 
achieve to surpass her Tiara Umamusume 
predecessors...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, after her Trainer advised her 
that she didn't need to be the first in 
history, she remembered: shining as her 
true self was the goal she had always 
strived for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Air Groove and the others 
attending the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
noticed a growing interest in former Tiara 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cause was, of course, the brilliant 
performances of Rinekraft and the others. 
Amid soaring attention, the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen begins—
